chunks.text: Last year I was bouncing around a lot—caught a couple movies in Shanghai just to kill time between errands.
And yeah, we were also talking about restaurants in Shanghai back then—my cousin kept hyping up this one place like it was life-changing.
I even had to deal with home services in Shanghai around that time… total headache, but it all got sorted eventually.
Oh—and on a different trip we stayed in Beijing, so hotels there were a whole separate conversation.
For the movie thing, my friend Wang Fang actually bought a single ticket for YOLO—one seat—so I just tagged along and didn’t handle any of it.
She picked Wanda Cinema Wujiaochang too, and the showtime was 17:00—honestly it worked out perfectly with our schedule that day.
Then for lunch on 2025-03-04, Liu Yang reserved Chuanfu Laozao for 9 people—he put it under his name and used 13812345678.

I remember the reservation time was 11:30, and later that month he also scheduled a morning home-service visit on 2025-03-24 to Room 203, Building C, West Apartment, with the contact number 13845678901—so yeah, everything was already booked and done.
